newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton settles weaker, continues in range.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton settles weaker, continues in range.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed a thinly traded session mixed as a lack of fundamental news continued to blunt activity, floor sources said.
Volume was estimated at 8,500 lots against Wednedsay's official 8,640 lots.
The market set its 35-point trading range early and then drifted in slow rangebound dealings for the rest of the day.
July cotton settled 0.02 cent weaker at 73.10 cents a lb, traded 73.40 to 73.05 cents. New-crop December went out 0.03 cent lower at 75.62 cents.
Dealers said July will need to overcome 74.10 cents in order to attract fresh fund buying, but a lack of bullish fundamental news could keep the market in its recent sideways pattern.
